repayment_method: Orderly voluntary wind-down with user-initiated bank and crypto withdrawals during announced withdrawal windows
notes: Stage 2 review resolves the platform-wide outcome semantics as `not_applicable`, not `full_repayment`. Pillow announced a voluntary wind-down rather than an insolvency or creditor-recovery process and told users that deposits and accrued interest were available for withdrawal, with bank withdrawals open through 7 July 2023 and crypto withdrawals through the 31 July 2023 closure. A platform-wide recovery percentage is therefore not the appropriate model. CYA does not claim that every customer completed withdrawal, that every balance was recovered successfully, or that withdrawal availability proves broader solvency beyond the announced wind-down process.

estimated_recovery_rate: No universal final recovery rate is assigned; Celsius distributions are claim-specific and continued through multiple rounds.
repayment_method: Celsius Chapter 11 plan distributions through approved distribution partners
claim_classes: Celsius General Earn Claims or other claim classification assigned through the Celsius process
notes: Ordinary Nuri bank balances, custody wallets and self-custodial vaults are outside this outcome. Former Nuri interest-account users depend on their individual Celsius claim and distribution status.
